plugin_ldap.title: LDAP/AD Login
plugin_ldap.description: Free basic LDAP/AD login: LDAP is tried after local password fails. Install the plugin separately as needed.
plugin_ldap.tlsHint: LDAPS encrypts from the start (port 636); StartTLS upgrades a plain connection (389). Pick one.
plugin_ldap.bindDnHint: DN of the service account; AD also accepts user@example.com. Leave empty for anonymous search.
plugin_ldap.serverTypeHint: Fill the user filter and attributes for the directory type with one click; edit freely afterwards.
plugin_ldap.filterHint: %s is replaced with the login name. OpenLDAP usually uses (uid=%s); AD uses (sAMAccountName=%s).
plugin_ldap.attrUsernameHint: AD usually uses sAMAccountName; OpenLDAP uses uid.
plugin_ldap.defaultRoleHint: Role code granted when an account is auto-created; empty means guest. Only applies at creation time.
plugin_ldap.testHint: Testing uses the current form values (including unsaved changes); a blank bind password falls back to the saved one.
plugin_ldap.caCertHint: Leave empty to use system roots; paste your internal CA certificate(s) for self-signed LDAP.
